name: agentsoma
description: Observe and operate a connected physical iPhone with the AgentSoma CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Eyes and hands for agents on a real iPhone.
interface.longDescription: Discover iPhone apps, read screenshots and accessibility data, and act through a persistent XCTest session. Requires the AgentSoma CLI, a Mac with full Xcode, and local Apple development signing.
defaultPrompt: Open Settings on my iPhone, navigate to General, verify the screen, then disconnect.
